patient.name: 美纱
patient.diagnosis: 成年医疗 AU：复杂胸段降主动脉瘤，需左开胸，在远端灌注及脊髓供血保护下切除病变血管段并行人工血管置换。限胸降主动脉，不涉及胸腹段内脏分支。
patient.diagnosis_en: Adult medical AU: Complex descending thoracic aortic aneurysm requiring open left thoracotomy and prosthetic graft replacement under distal perfusion and spinal-cord protection. Limited to the descending thoracic aorta without abdominal visceral-branch reconstruction.

day1.title: 明天要换掉一段大动脉
day1.title_en: Tomorrow, Part of an Aorta Will Be Replaced

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 美纱先看示意图，再看坂口，像是想确认图里那段隆起的血管真的在自己身体里。
lines.text_en: Misa looks at the diagram, then at Sakaguchi, as if trying to confirm that the bulging section of blood vessel in the picture really is inside her body.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「你们准备……把这一段切掉？」
lines.text_en: “You're planning to... cut this part out?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「切除病变段，用人工血管完成重建。」
lines.text_en: “Remove the diseased segment and replace it with a synthetic graft.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我知道。转诊医生也说过。可是你指着图说出来的时候，怎么听着比诊断书还吓人。」
lines.text_en: “I know. The referring doctor told me. But hearing you say it while pointing at the picture is somehow scarier than reading the diagnosis.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「最难的部分不仅是缝上人工血管，还要保护置换过程中下半身和脊髓的血流。」
lines.text_en: “The difficult part isn't just sewing in the graft. We also have to protect blood flow to your lower body and spinal cord during replacement.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「所以它不只是‘把旧的换成新的’。」
lines.text_en: “So it's not simply 'take out the old one and put in a new one.'”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「对。要建立远端灌注，确认需要保留的分支，再逐段完成重建。」
lines.text_en: “Right. We need distal perfusion, identification of the branches to preserve, and a careful staged reconstruction.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我一直以为病人听不懂手术细节会害怕。现在听懂一点，好像更害怕了。」
lines.text_en: “I always thought patients were scared because they didn't understand surgery. Now I understand a little, and I'm even more scared.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「这是全麻手术。手术中你不会需要自己承受这些操作。」
lines.text_en: “You'll be under general anesthesia. You won't be awake for those procedures.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那我睡一觉醒来，这么重要的一根血管就有一段不是原装的了？」
lines.text_en: “So I'll fall asleep and wake up with part of a major blood vessel no longer being the original?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「可以这样理解。我们会检查置换后的通畅情况，确认状态稳定再结束。」
lines.text_en: “That's one way to put it. We'll verify flow through the replacement and make sure your condition is stable before we finish.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……真了不起。也真荒唐。我还没决定明天早餐想吃什么，你们已经排好了要在我胸口里做的全部事情。」
lines.text_en: “...That's remarkable. And absurd. I haven't even decided what I'd like for breakfast tomorrow, and you've already planned everything you're doing inside my chest.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「明天术前会按麻醉要求禁食。今天还有什么担心的，尽管说。」
lines.text_en: “You'll need to fast before anesthesia tomorrow. If anything else worries you, tell me today.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……能不能至少让我见见明天要在手术台旁站一整天的那些人？」
lines.text_en: “...Could I at least meet the people who'll be standing beside the operating table all day tomorrow?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「可以。马上就要开术前会议。」
lines.text_en: “Of course. The preoperative briefing is about to begin.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那我可得记住你们每个人的脸。等我醒了，好知道该向谁抱怨。」
lines.text_en: “Then I'd better remember every face. So I'll know exactly whom to complain to when I wake up.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 美纱努力笑了笑，把影像报告转正推回给坂口。镜头切到专科难点提示及 Grand OR 编组界面。
lines.text_en: Misa makes an effort to smile, straightens the imaging report, and pushes it back toward Sakaguchi. The view cuts to the specialty challenge notes and Grand OR team selection screen.

day3.title: 不是原装的，也要好好用
day3.title_en: Not Original, Still Worth Taking Care Of

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 美纱醒来后第一件事，是低头看看盖着病号服的胸口。
lines.text_en: The first thing Misa does after waking is look down at her chest, covered by her hospital gown.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「所以……换好了？」
lines.text_en: “So... it's been replaced?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「病变的降主动脉段已经置换，血流复核结果稳定。还要继续观察和恢复。」
lines.text_en: “The affected descending aorta has been replaced, and the blood-flow check was stable. You'll still need monitoring and recovery.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「明明是自己身体里最重要的东西之一，动完手术却只能听你向我汇报。」
lines.text_en: “It's one of the most important things inside my own body, yet all I can do afterward is hear you report on it.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「这是全麻的好处。」
lines.text_en: “That's the benefit of general anesthesia.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……也是。真让我全程看着，你们大概会嫌我话太多。」
lines.text_en: “...I suppose so. If I'd been watching the whole time, you'd probably have complained that I talked too much.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「恢复期也别太勉强。」
lines.text_en: “Don't overdo it during recovery.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「好吧。从今天起，我至少得学会对自己那段新血管客气一点。」
lines.text_en: “All right. From today on, I suppose I ought to treat that new piece of blood vessel with a little respect.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 她笑了一下，随后有些疲惫地闭上眼。进入现有 Day 3 成功结算画面。
lines.text_en: She smiles, then closes her eyes with a hint of exhaustion. Proceed to the existing Day 3 success results screen.
